diagnosis: SA-09 incorrectly consumes the global genesis exploration budget as the local recovery-liveness budget. The counterexample is a valid exact ledger-ahead state at global depth 5. Only 7 global transitions remain under MAX_DEPTH=12, while the current witness definition requires up to 8 local transitions to reconcile the current issuance, issue one clean next generation, reconcile that generation, and perform the modeled trusted-minimum consequential use. The failure therefore depends on when a state is discovered from genesis rather than on whether that state has a bounded clean recovery path. The same defect would systematically make sufficiently late recoverable states fail even when their protocol recovery is valid.
repair_constraint: Do not change any authority safety rule, pair-status classification, reconciliation target, mutant expectation, generation bound, or global safety-search depth. Give SA-09 a separately explicit fixed local recovery bound sufficient for its frozen recovery-plus-next-generation obligation, and preserve the global BFS depth at 12.

planned_pre_scientific_correction.rationale: Eight is the exact worst-case modeled clean path: reconcile ledger-ahead state (write temp, replace anchor, store receipt = 3), issue next generation (1), reconcile it (3), perform trusted-minimum consequential use (1).
